description.en-US: Benson's lecture on mysticism (1907), delivered at Westminster, with a preface: what the mystical experience is, how the Catholic Church understands it and its place in the Christian life.
description.pt-BR: A conferência de Benson sobre o misticismo (1907), proferida em Westminster, com um prefácio: o que é a experiência mística, como a Igreja Católica a entende e seu lugar na vida cristã.

en-US.editor: Robert Hugh Benson (London: Catholic Truth Society, 1907)

sources.edition: Mysticism (London: Catholic Truth Society, 1907), Internet Archive full-text OCR (Mysticism1907).
sources.description: Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Mgr. Robert Hugh Benson died in 1914 and the edition is of 1907, so the text is public domain.
